title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning by NWS - NewsBreak
text:
33 minutes ago Check NWS updates here
Effective: 2026-06-24 22:08:00 MDT Expires: 2026-06-24 23:00:00 MDT Urgency: Immediate Severity: Severe Certainty: Observed Instruction: Anyone outdoors should move to shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from windows. This storm is capable of producing dangerous hail and damaging winds. A Tornado Watch remains in effect until 1100 PM MDT Wednesday for portions of east central and northeast Colorado. Target Area: Central Arapahoe, CO; Eastern Arapahoe, CO; Elbert, CO SVRBOU
The National Weather Service in Denver has issued a
* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for... Northeastern Elbert County in east central Colorado... Central Arapahoe and Eastern Arapahoe County in northeastern Colorado...
* Until 1100 PM MDT.
* At 1008 PM MDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over Deer Trail, or 29 miles northwest of Limon, moving east at 15 mph.
HAZARD...Two inch hail and 60 mph wind gusts.
SOURCE...Radar indicated.
IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect hail damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles. Expect wind damage to roofs, siding, and trees.
* Locations impacted include... Deer Trail and Cottonwood Valley.
